scripts.vendor:bootstrap: mkdir -p static/lfs_theme/vendor/bootstrap && cp node_modules/bootstrap/dist/js/bootstrap.bundle.min.js static/lfs_theme/vendor/bootstrap/ && cp node_modules/bootstrap/dist/js/bootstrap.bundle.min.js.map static/lfs_theme/vendor/bootstrap/
scripts.vendor:bootstrap-icons: mkdir -p static/lfs_theme/vendor/bootstrap-icons/fonts && cp node_modules/bootstrap-icons/font/bootstrap-icons.css static/lfs_theme/vendor/bootstrap-icons/ && cp node_modules/bootstrap-icons/font/bootstrap-icons.min.css static/lfs_theme/vendor/bootstrap-icons/ && cp node_modules/bootstrap-icons/font/bootstrap-icons.json static/lfs_theme/vendor/bootstrap-icons/ && cp node_modules/bootstrap-icons/font/bootstrap-icons.scss static/lfs_theme/vendor/bootstrap-icons/ && cp node_modules/bootstrap-icons/font/fonts/* static/lfs_theme/vendor/bootstrap-icons/fonts/
scripts.vendor:swiper: mkdir -p static/lfs_theme/vendor/swiper && cp node_modules/swiper/swiper-bundle.min.js static/lfs_theme/vendor/swiper/ && cp node_modules/swiper/swiper-bundle.min.js.map static/lfs_theme/vendor/swiper/ && cp node_modules/swiper/swiper-bundle.min.css static/lfs_theme/vendor/swiper/
scripts.vendor:update: npm run vendor:clean && npm run vendor:bootstrap && npm run vendor:bootstrap-icons && npm run vendor:swiper && npm run vendor:htmx
scripts.build: npm run vendor:update && npm run build:css
